name: council
description: Run council reviews with best-fit sourced engineering reviewer agents

interface.longDescription: Council from the SAI Codex collection. Runs focused or broad reviews through native reviewer agents with sourced engineering, UX, reliability, performance, and strategy lenses, then synthesizes convergence, disagreement, and concrete next moves.
defaultPrompt: Use $council to review this code or plan with best-fit reviewers.
Use $council all for a broad engineering and UX review.
Use $council debate to compare hard tradeoffs.
